script_nghe: How was your holiday? … Lovely. We went to Sapa. … Did you fly? … No, we travelled by train — much cheaper. … How long did you stay? … Five nights. Well, we booked four but we stayed an extra one. … And the weather? … Mostly foggy, unfortunately. … What did you enjoy most? … Definitely the cooking class. I learned to make three local dishes.

**HOLIDAY REPORT**

- Place visited: **1** ____________
- Travelled by: **2** ____________
- Stayed for: **3** ____________ nights
- Weather: mostly **4** ____________

> **A change of career**
> 
> Linh worked as a bank clerk for six years. She earned a good salary, but she never really enjoyed the job. In 2021 the bank closed her branch and offered her a position in another city. She decided not to accept it.
> 
> Instead, she used her savings to open a small bakery near her home. The first year was extremely difficult. She started work at four every morning and often finished after eight in the evening. She almost closed the business twice. Then a local food blogger visited the shop and posted about her bread. Orders increased sharply, and last year she employed her first two members of staff.

**True / False / Not Given (6–8):**
6. Linh disliked her job at the bank.
7. Linh accepted the position in another city.
8. The blogger was a friend of Linh’s.

**Hoàn thành câu (9–11):**
9. Linh worked at the bank for ____________ years.
10. She used her ____________ to open the bakery.
11. Last year she employed ____________ members of staff.

writing.de_tom_tat: Viết 70–80 từ kể lại cuối tuần vừa rồi, dùng ít nhất 6 động từ quá khứ có quy tắc.
writing.bai_mau: Last Saturday I stayed at home in the morning and cleaned my flat. Then I walked to a coffee shop near my house and worked on a small project for two hours. In the afternoon I called my parents and we talked for a long time. After that I watched a film. On Sunday I didn't do much — I just relaxed and finished a book I started last month.

cham_diem.vi_sao: stayed · cleaned · walked · worked · called · talked · watched · relaxed · finished — 9 động từ, viết đúng hết. Chú ý stay → stayed (nguyên âm + y thì giữ y).
I didn't do much — sau didn't thì động từ về nguyên mẫu, KHÔNG dùng did.
Then I walked · In the afternoon · After that I watched · On Sunday.

dang_hoc: Quy tắc thêm -ed: phụ âm + y → đổi thành ied (study → studied), nhưng nguyên âm + y thì giữ nguyên (stay → stayed).
Ba cách đọc đuôi -ed: /t/ sau âm vô thanh (walked, watched) · /d/ sau âm hữu thanh (called, cleaned) · /ɪd/ sau t/d (wanted, needed).
Sau didn't luôn là nguyên mẫu: didn't do, didn't go, didn't have.
loi_thuong_gap: ❌ I didn't did much → ✅ I didn't do much
❌ Yesterday I go to work → ✅ Yesterday I went to work

speaking.de_tom_tat: What did you do last weekend? / When did you last travel somewhere new? / How was your day yesterday?

cau_tra_loi.hoi: What did you do last weekend?
cau_tra_loi.mau: Nothing special, really. I cleaned my flat on Saturday morning, then I worked in a coffee shop for a couple of hours. On Sunday I just relaxed and finished a book.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: “Nothing special, really” — câu mở đầu tự nhiên, đừng nghĩ phải kể chuyện hay mới được điểm.

cau_tra_loi.hoi: When did you last travel somewhere new?
cau_tra_loi.mau: About six months ago. I visited Da Lat for the first time. We stayed for three days and walked around the lake a lot.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: Câu hỏi “when did you last…” thì trả lời bằng khoảng thời gian: “about six months ago”.

cau_tra_loi.mau: Busy but productive. I had three meetings in the morning, and in the afternoon I finished a report I'd been working on for a week.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: “Busy but productive” — trả lời bằng hai tính từ đối lập, rất tự nhiên và gọn.

cham_diem.vi_sao: Đủ, đều dùng quá khứ đơn.
cleaned /d/ · worked /t/ · visited /ɪd/ — ba cách khác nhau, phải bật ra chứ không nuốt.

meo_noi: Đây là tiêu chí chấm riêng của unit này: đuôi -ed phải nghe ra được. Người Việt nuốt âm cuối là mất điểm ngay.
Luyện riêng 3 cách: walked /wɔːkt/ · called /kɔːld/ · wanted /ˈwɒntɪd/.
